d: Watch as Firstpost examines Captain Ibrahim Traoré’s massive security mobilization in Burkina Faso, as over 86,000 citizen reservists sign up to bolster the nation's defense forces. Under a new law, Ouagadougou has established a formal military reserve framework aimed at integrating both veteran forces and patriotic civilian volunteers to secure national sovereignty and counter regional security threats. As Burkina Faso continues its decisive break from Western defense dependency and aligns with its Sahel partners, this unprecedented draft of 86,000 citizens marks a major institutional…
